Forb in a compact interval approaching1, the coefficients andsup_I|phi_b| are uniformly bounded by some finiteC. Choose fixed0<eta<c/(2C). The learner can also calculate the maximum spectral mass compatible with its observations at a particular, nearly nondecaying relaxation rate.

This is the classical Christoffel variational formula, combined with a constructive Gauss–Radau spectral witness.
